summary: First iteration full test of NEXUS OS (Expo RN + FastAPI). Backend: 20/20 pytest passed against the public preview URL (https://home-nexus-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com/api). All endpoints in the request work: /nexus/info (hostname RASPBERRY-TENSHI, ip 192.168.12.177), /system (all telemetry fields), /docker (6 containers, start/stop/restart/logs all functional, 404 on unknown), /homeassistant/devices (42 devices, counts populated), /homeassistant/toggle (light/switch toggle, sensors rejected with 400), /ollama/models (claude-sonnet-4.5 listed) and /ollama/chat (real Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply via emergentintegrations), /audio/play|stop|volume|tts, /network/scan (central RASPBERRY-TENSHI = n1), /logs and /logs/clear, /terminal/exec (uptime, help, unknown). Frontend: All flows verified via mobile-viewport Playwright (390x844). Boot screen typewriter completes and ENTER NEXUS button routes to /(tabs)/dashboard. Dashboard renders all 12 expected testIDs (metric-cpu/ram/temp/net, status-docker/ha/ollama, log-feed, action-restart/sync/clear-logs/deploy). Bottom-tab nav works for all 7 tabs (dash, docker, home, ai, network, audio, terminal). Docker: container cards listed, START/STOP/LOGS work, logs modal opens and closes. Home: filter chips render, light toggle fires. AI: send Claude message returns assistant bubble. Network: SVG topology renders, tapping node n2 opens node-details. Audio: play/pause and TTS speak fire. Terminal: help+uptime commands return shell output, history prev/next visible. UI looks great (tactical green HUD, scanlines, count-up). No backend issues. No critical frontend issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Web bundle shows repeated warnings: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use textShadow), 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), and Invalid DOM property 'transform-origin' (should be transformOrigin). These are RN Web compatibility warnings that should be cleaned up in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and any component using textShadowColor/textShadowRadius/shadow*. Functionality is unaffected.

Console reports 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Likely triggered by an older Touchable* import inside one of the SVG/network or animation components. Consider migrating any TouchableWithoutFeedback/TouchableOpacity callers to Pressable where applicable.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Replace textShadow*/shadow* style props with the new RN consolidated 'textShadow'/'boxShadow' to silence web console warnings.
(Cosmetic) Replace any remaining TouchableMixin / Touchable* usage with Pressable to align with current RN guidance.
(Cosmetic) Audit any animated transform style passing 'transform-origin' as a DOM-style key on web; use transformOrigin (camelCase) so RN Web does not warn.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured, uses async motor, excludes Mongo _id via projection in /logs, and proxies errors with HTTPException. Good.
frontend/src/api.ts correctly uses API_BASE derived from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. No hardcoded URLs found.
All interactive elements expose testID — testing coverage is excellent.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend uses in-memory mock state which is seeded automatically at startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_api.py and target the public preview URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Mock state is server-side in-memory; restarting backend resets container states and HA toggles. The Claude chat test (/api/ollama/chat) takes ~10-20s — keep timeout >= 60s. Frontend uses Expo Router; boot screen takes ~3s to finish typewriter before [ENTER NEXUS] appears.
